finalCoverage.lod: Captured one LOD snapshot after the near-tile burn: trees LOD [0,1637,2132], 3,769 instances, 57,981 triangles, overflow 0; characters LOD [0,17,51], 68 instances, 408 triangles, overflow 0; buildings 0 instances. No explicit forced near-to-far LOD transition/tint check.
finalCoverage.resources: Single 3D burn/update sample: renderer memory geometries 9 before and 11 after settled update; textures 4 before and after. This covers one event only, not repeated-update/long-run stability.
otherLimits: Narrow viewport check verified document scrollWidth <= 960, but the observer panel buttons were all hidden (zero-sized) after the world reset, so visible observer-panel clipping was not exercised at narrow width.
The bounded refresh sample was 30 selections at radius 3, each reporting 49 cells visited; measured 3.2 ms for the batch and is not a performance claim.
